title: FailureAcknowledged
description: Schema for FailureAcknowledged.json — the list of acknowledged test failures used by the 5-Tier Failure-Acknowledged gate.

testName.description: Full test name or 'ClassName.TestName' identifying the failing test. Must match the name or 'classname.name' produced by the test runner.

tier.description: The tier up to which this failure is acknowledged. T1=Sprint/Experimental, T2=Alpha/Development, T3=Beta/Integration, T4=QA, T5=Production. Gate passes at tier T when entry.tier rank >= gate tier rank.

category.description: Optional test category for grouping (e.g., Unit, Integration).

issueNumber.description: Optional tracking identifier (e.g., GitHub issue number) for the underlying defect.

acknowledgedBy.description: Optional name or username of the person who acknowledged this failure.

date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this failure was acknowledged.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes explaining why this failure is acknowledged.
